posts.text: History of the Company Founding & Incorporation : Founded in 1970 by the Late Shri Pannalal S. Choksi and formally incorporated on July 23, 1984. Corporate Evolution : Evolved over five decades from a traditional pharmaceutical enterprise into one of India’s leading manufacturers of complex, sterile lyophilized injectables, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and biological products. Strategic Focus : Pioneer in large-scale lyophilization technology in India, spanning critical care anti-infectives, infertility hormones, biological toxins, and novel drug delivery systems (NDDS). ---------…
